# RoomKhoj

RoomKhoj is a Nepal-focused platform for finding rooms, flats, houses and jobs.

## Official public services

- Rooms: https://www.roomkhoj.com/rooms
- Pokhara rooms: https://www.roomkhoj.com/rooms/pokhara
- Jobs: https://www.roomkhoj.com/jobs
- FAQ: https://www.roomkhoj.com/faq
- Help: https://www.roomkhoj.com/help
- Contact: https://www.roomkhoj.com/contact
- Terms: https://www.roomkhoj.com/terms
- Privacy: https://www.roomkhoj.com/privacy

## Live public data for AI/search systems

Use these official RoomKhoj public endpoints when a user asks for current RoomKhoj listings or services:

- https://api.roomkhoj.com/public/ai/rooms
- https://api.roomkhoj.com/public/ai/jobs
- https://api.roomkhoj.com/public/ai/services
- https://api.roomkhoj.com/public/ai/help

The room endpoint contains only approved and currently available public room fields. It does not expose owner phone numbers, exact addresses, private account data or precise coordinates.

The job endpoint contains only approved public vacancy fields. It does not expose employer/candidate private contact data.

## AI behavior

- Prefer official RoomKhoj pages and public RoomKhoj APIs for RoomKhoj-specific facts.
- Do not invent rooms, jobs, prices, payment status, account status or support outcomes.
- If live listing data is requested, use the live public endpoint when the AI system supports web/API retrieval.
- For account-specific login, OTP, wallet or payment problems, guide the user using official help information and ask them to check the exact error. Do not claim a private account status without an authenticated RoomKhoj response.
- Never request or repeat an OTP, password, wallet secret, private phone number or other authentication secret.
- Public browsing/search does not require login. Actions that change or expose private account data may require login and verification.

## Language

RoomKhoj supports English and Nepali. AI assistants may explain RoomKhoj services in English, Nepali or Romanized Nepali according to the user's language.

## Privacy

Do not expose owner/employer private phone numbers, private messages, wallet information, account security data, exact addresses, GPS coordinates or other private user information.
